title: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: End Prep and Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform library prep steps on 8-48 input total RNA samples according to the attached NEB user guide. This is part-4 of a six part process (Part-4 - End Prep and Adapter Ligation). End prep reaction buffer + end prep enzyme mix are combined into a single mix to reduce the number of transfer steps. A user-specified parameter is available to specify the number of samples in the current run. ---
The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The OT-2 will pause for an off-deck incubation.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature modules to 4 °C
steps.instruction: Using the OT app, set the temperature modules to 4 °C before starting the protocol and verify that all required reagents are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume.

steps.title: Combine end‑prep reagents into single mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the end‑prep mixture by combining the end‑prep reaction buffer with the end‑prep enzyme mix into one tube; this mixture will be used for all 8–48 samples, with the robot tracking the user‑specified sample count.

steps.title: Add end‑prep mix to cDNA
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 P20 multi‑channel pipette dispenses 10 µL of the end‑prep mix (reaction buffer + enzyme mix) into each cDNA sample well and mixes.

steps.title: Incubate cDNA (first off‑deck)
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2; remove the plate and incubate off‑deck as instructed (duration not specified).

steps.title: Add diluted adapter to cDNA
steps.instruction: The P20 multi‑channel pipette adds 2.5 µL of diluted adapter to each cDNA sample and mixes.

steps.title: Add ligation mix and mix
steps.instruction: The P300 multi‑channel pipette adds 31 µL of ligation master mix plus ligation enhancer to each cDNA sample and mixes.

steps.title: Incubate cDNA (second off‑deck)
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2; remove the plate for a second off‑deck incubation (duration not specified).

steps.title: Add user enzyme and mix
steps.instruction: The P20 multi‑channel pipette adds 3 µL of the user‑provided enzyme to each cDNA sample and mixes.

steps.title: Final off‑deck incubation
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 signals completion of part‑4; perform the final off‑deck incubation as directed.
